newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber adds Schering to focus list.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber adds Schering to focus list.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc said on Wednesday its retail division added Schering Plough Corp to the PaineWebber Focus List, which is comprised of stocks rated buy or attractive by the firm's research department.

The list is a theoretical portfolio of no more than 30 stocks. It is derived from firm research but developed by a committee made up mostly of senior members of the retail division who use fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, PaineWebber said.
A stock was removed from the list when it was downgraded or fell below certain price criteria, the firm said.
The analyst was not immediately available to comment.
